beats.text: Machu Picchu, the enigmatic citadel, perched 2,430 meters high in the Andes, is one of the most iconic symbols of the Inca civilization.
beats.say: Machu Picchu, the enigmatic citadel, perched 2,430 meters high in the Andes, is one of the most iconic symbols of the Inca civilization.

beats.text: Built around 1450, it served as an estate for Inca Emperor Pachacuti, though no contemporary written records exist to confirm this.
beats.say: Built around 1450, it served as an estate for Inca Emperor Pachacuti, though no contemporary written records exist to confirm this.

beats.text: Occupied until the Spanish conquest, it was abandoned for nearly five centuries, with modern radiocarbon dating placing its occupation between c. 1420 and 1530.
beats.say: Occupied until the Spanish conquest, it was abandoned for nearly five centuries, with modern radiocarbon dating placing its occupation between c. 1420 and 1530.

beats.text: Rediscovered in 1911 by Hiram Bingham, it's now a UNESCO World Heritage Site, featuring finely crafted dry-stone walls and notable structures like the Temple of the Sun and the Intihuatana ritual stone.
beats.say: Rediscovered in 1911 by Hiram Bingham, it's now a UNESCO World Heritage Site, featuring finely crafted dry-stone walls and notable structures like the Temple of the Sun and the Intihuatana ritual stone.

beats.text: Explore its terraces, temples, and the Intihuatana stone, which is believed to have been a solar clock.
beats.say: Explore its terraces, temples, and the Intihuatana stone, which is believed to have been a solar clock.

beats.text: Machu Picchu, Peru's most visited tourist destination, receives over 1.5 million visitors annually.
beats.say: Machu Picchu, Peru's most visited tourist destination, receives over 1.5 million visitors annually.

facts.quote: Estimated to be built around 1450, it is believed to have served as an estate for the Inca emperor Pachacuti.

facts.claim: Machu Picchu was occupied from around 1420 to 1530.
facts.quote: Similar conclusions supporting an earlier 15th-century chronology have been reported by other radiocarbon studies.

facts.claim: It was rediscovered in 1911 by Hiram Bingham.
facts.quote: The site was brought to international attention in 1911 by the American historian Hiram Bingham III.

youtube.description:
Machu Picchu, the enigmatic citadel, was built around 1450 as an estate for Inca Emperor Pachacuti, and was occupied until the Spanish conquest in the 16th century. Rediscovered in 1911, it's now a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Follow ORDELVA for more. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machu_Picchu
